title: micranthes lyallii subsp. hultenii
intro: Micranthes lyallii subsp. hultenii, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a plant species within the Saxifragaceae family, native to high-altitude regions. Alpine Cinquefoil is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. Research suggests that the therapeutic actions of Alpine Cinquefoil may include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities, making it a potential natural remedy against various infections. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
